text:
maria_ops: Heads up — we rolled BMC firmware v2.15.0 to a subset of us-west-2 at 04:05 UTC. Seeing unusual RTC jitter on ~12 racks; OOB sessions dropping and DHCP renewals timestamp-skewed. Affected hosts stuck in provisioning/gpu-alloc state.
ajay_oncall: how widespread? which pools impacted?
kelly_infra: looks like two GPU pools (g4-pool-12, g4-pool-15) are showing pending allocations and increased backfill time. Capacity hit ~18% for those pools.
zack_hw: grabbing serial logs from one affected node, pasted below. Noting UEFI variable write failures followed by a SecureBoot state flip on one board.
zack_hw: ```
[04:06:11] bmc: rtc: jitter detected: delta=+4.2s
[04:06:11] firmware: nvram write err - EIO
[04:06:11] uefi: variable update failed (SecureBoot)
[04:06:12] oob: ipmi session drop, keepalive missed=3
```
maria_ops: who triggered this batch? I thought the rollout was staged with canary.
ci-bot: rollout/bmc/v2.15.0 started by kelly_infra — stage: zone-canary -> us-west-2-staged (12 racks). See: https://ci.internal/rollouts/bmc/v2.15.0
ajay_oncall: that matches. Canary passed, but these nodes were in a different BIOS minor revision (0x1a vs 0x18). Looks like corner-case interaction with RTC drift + nvram write path.
kelly_infra: confirmed: canary was on boards with BIOS 0x18. The fleet subset in us-west-2 has mixed BIOS levels. Need to pause. @ci-bot pause rollout?
ci-bot: pause requested by kelly_infra. Rollout paused.
sre_rotations: impact summary — provisioning backlog causing 12 racks to hold ~2-3 jobs each. Estimated ETA to clear if no mitigation: 3-4 hours, unit cost increase expected due to retries.
zack_hw: found one reproducible repro: flash sequence attempts nvram write during rtc adjust and returns EIO; firmware then falls back and toggles UEFI SecureBoot variable to 'Off' to continue booting. That triggers our attestation check and the node is placed in quarantine.
maria_ops: ok, mitigation options: 1) rollback BMC to previous build on affected racks, 2) patch run with nvram write retry backoff, 3) temporarily whitelist attestation for those hosts to unblock provisioning. Thoughts?
ajay_oncall: short-term: rollback affected BMCs to v2.14.0 for the 12 racks. Medium-term: add nvram write retry + detect BIOS minor mismatch in rollout gating.
kelly_infra: started rollback job for the 12 racks — command: `infra-rollout rollback --target rackset:usw2-racks-202 --image bmc:v2.14.0 --parallel 3`
ci-bot: rollback job 8791 queued, ops-run-keeper attached.
sre_rotations: watch GPU metrics and scheduler pending queue, we should rehydrate capacity with preemptible falls if needed. Alerting threshold lowered to 60s for pool-failures.
zack_hw: added a temporary runbook note: https://go/runbooks/bmc-rtc-jitter (internal) with log snippet and NVMe/NVRAM checks.
maria_ops: rollback started at 04:17 UTC. Please post if you see any nodes where SecureBoot remains toggled off after rollback — we need keys re-provisioned for attestation.
kelly_infra: seeing first rack back healthy (rack-12a), gpu allocations resuming. Will continue rollbacks in waves of 3 racks.
ajay_oncall: cost note — excess provisioning retries may add ~0.8k USD/hr until cleared. Finance notified.
sre_rotations: adding follow-up ticket to track gating by BIOS minor revision and adding pre-roll checks.
maria_ops: thanks everyone. If you have affected hosts, prefix messages with "AFFECTED HOSTS:" so we can triage quickly. I'll stay on this thread until pools are stable. :thumbsup:
